description: This file defines the LivenessTestGrain class, a grain implementation for testing liveness in Orleans. It includes methods for lifecycle management, setting and getting labels, starting timers, and retrieving grain identifiers.

classes.name: LivenessTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain used for testing liveness, with label management, timers, and identity retrieval.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation; initializes the label and unique ID, and checks primary key constraints.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation and logs the event.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the current label of the grain.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets a new label for the grain and logs the update.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a grain timer that triggers TimerTick every 10 seconds.

methods.name: TimerTick
methods.description: Method called when the timer ticks; logs the tick.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique GUID identifier for the grain instance.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to this grain cast as ILivenessTestGrain.
